temperature_c.source: FAO Cultured Aquatic Species Information Programme, Oreochromis niloticus (FAO, 2012) — survival limits; commonly cited optimal growth range from recent growth-performance studies.
temperature_c.caveat: This range is a sanity-check flag from a limited literature search, not a verified universal threshold — confirm against current, strain/system-specific literature before citing it in a manuscript.

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.source: Nile tilapia is broadly oxygen-tolerant relative to other cultured species (FAO CASIP); one growth-performance study reports optimal DO 5.49-5.87 mg/L. Treat as approximate, not a strict cutoff.
dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.caveat: This range is a sanity-check flag from a limited literature search, not a verified universal threshold — confirm against current, strain/system-specific literature before citing it in a manuscript.

ph.source: Commonly cited tolerant range across recent Nile tilapia water-quality studies (e.g. Fisheries and Aquatic Sciences 20:30, 2017).
ph.caveat: This range is a sanity-check flag from a limited literature search, not a verified universal threshold — confirm against current, strain/system-specific literature before citing it in a manuscript.

total_ammonia_nitrogen_mg_l.source: Reported optimal TAN range 0.29-0.34 mg/L in a Nile tilapia juvenile growth study; check unionized-fraction toxicity separately via calculate_unionized_ammonia, since TAN alone doesn't determine toxicity.
total_ammonia_nitrogen_mg_l.caveat: This range is a sanity-check flag from a limited literature search, not a verified universal threshold — confirm against current, strain/system-specific literature before citing it in a manuscript.
